notes: Firmographics: mid-market SaaS (B2B product analytics). HQ: Denver, CO. 320 employees. Heavily product engineering led.
Initial contact: signed up for Redwood hosted API trial (Aug 2025) to evaluate embeddings + chat flows for in-app assistant.
POC summary: Hosted API POC completed 2025-10-15. 3 endpoints tested: chat (LLM chat flow), embeddings (semantic search), reranker (in-serp relevance).
Performance: during POC they reported avg p50 latencies ~180ms for short chat turns using hosted endpoints; target for Dedicated is p50 <150ms at 50 rps sustained.
Cost sensitivity: focused on unit economics — wants model/quantization recommendations; target < $0.0009 per token equivalent for production chat volume.
Model preference: prefer open-ish models (Llama3-variant / Redwood-verified) with option to fallback to smaller quantized variant for high-volume routes.
Routing/fallback needs: route by SLA tier -> primary Dedicated cluster in us-west, fallback to hosted API in case of capacity; regional residency for EU customers (future requirement).
Security & compliance: requires SSO (SAML/Okta), customer-managed KMS for encrypted training/embedding keys, audit logs retention 1 year, data residency in US/EU selectable per tenant.

Procurement/legal: moved to procurement Nov 2025 after Exec demo. Legal provided redlines to MSA + DPA 2025-11-10. Key redline areas: data use prohibition, indemnity cap, export control carveouts, SLA credits and downtime measurement, termination rights.

MSA/DPA status: redlines captured in DRIVE doc (linked). Redwood legal & AE aligned on compromise on data use but Alcove insists on explicit non-training clause and 90-day data deletion post-termination.

SLA discussions: Alcove requests 99.95% uptime for Dedicated with clear credit schedule and measurement at route-level; Redwood proposed 99.9% for Dedicated plus fallback policy — negotiation ongoing.
Dedicated onboarding ask: architecture diagram for VPC peering + private subnet egress, KMS integration guide, runbook for failover to hosted endpoints.
POC -> Dedicated plan: 4-week pilot on Dedicated with mirrored workload from hosted POC, success metrics: latency p50/p95, token unit cost, error rate <0.5%.
Procurement checklist outstanding: SOC2 Type II report, ATO/penetration test summary, three customer references (requested), finalized pricing addendum.
Quote from CTO (call 2025-10-29): "We need predictable latency and a clear plan for key management before we can sign. If Redwood can show private KMS and SLA credits, we can move fast."
Notes from SE (Diego): proposed Dedicated config: 4x A100-equivalent nodes, autoscale floor 2, burst pool option. Suggested tune: KV-cache + prefix cache to reduce expensive context tokens.
Action items captured: AE to get SOC2 artifacts + reference list by 2025-11-24; Legal to respond to counter-redlines by 2025-11-25; Infra kickoff tentatively 2025-12-01 upon signature.
